notes.title: Update Alert!
notes.notes:
Hey Guys!

We've been listening to your feedback and working hard to further improve your experience with our game. We’re excited to share with you a few updates and changes!

Achievements have landed!
To unlock them one needs to play the game again. We’ve prepared some hidden achievements on your way through, so we didn’t want to spoil the fun.

We also have another big surprise for you, as AoF will be participating in the Weeklong sale starting from Monday, 24th of April. So for those of you who are still considering discovering the story behind Nate’s disappearance - here’s your chance (:

We are still focusing our efforts on further improving your experience with our game.

Lastly, we'd like to extend our thanks to all of you who have played Anthology of Fear and supported us through this journey. We couldn't have come this far without your feedback.


See you soon,
OhDeer Studio and 100 GAMES
